scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && node scripts/gen-version.mjs && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/api && npm run test --workspace=apps/web
